datePolicy: All cited source access dates are explicitly 2026-11-06 in the retained source ledger; source-specific document, rate and edition dates are separate. Undated provider publication dates remain unknown. No external refresh, publication date or article recheck date is invented.
uncertainties: Budgets assume eligible duty/tax relief on imported used effects. Any import assessment or temporary-import security is additional and cannot be priced until customs status and inventory are confirmed.
No exact 25 m³ or 10 m³ London–Toronto quote, April 2027 price/availability, packed container fit or air chargeable-weight contract. B freight and most ancillary costs are assumptions.
Cabin/checked Air Canada outbound London acceptance for the actual cat and flight is unresolved. Cat cargo allowance is not a ceiling; generic passenger pet fees are not cargo rates.
UK export EHC/EXA and 72-hour examination are separate from Canadian import minimums; 2027 airline, CFIA fee, rabies-free list and IATA requirements need rechecking.

Customs classification depends on each person’s intended employment duration, residence/landing history and actual settlement; temporary 9803 differs from settler 9807, including used-mattress treatment and status-change triggers.
No personal human-health coverage assessment is present in the retained material; no OHIP, NHS, insurance eligibility or waiting-period claims are added.

Indexed IKEA prices are not live checkout or Toronto stock; VALEVÅG 499 versus category 449 resolved conservatively to 499. April 2027 prices, delivery and quality-equivalent replacement remain unconfirmed.
CAD 7,988.45 is a conditional initial stage only; deferred guest bed adds assumed CAD 678 with HST before later delivery/price changes. Cat cargo staged version remains CAD 12,168.45.

Employer net allowance/tax, pet/rebuy reimbursement and deadlines unknown. Adult airfares, visas, housing/deposit, living, UK tenancy exit, car shipping and major customs examination/demurrage excluded; sale proceeds not promised.
